title: DEVOPS↔FE-001: Frontend Build/Deploy + Staging Environments
description: DevOps provides the CI/CD pipeline for frontend builds, staging/production environment provisioning with parity, a tested rollback path, frontend observability integration, and CDN/static-asset hosting; Frontend provides build/deploy requirements, per-environment configuration, and frontend performance/error budgets for SLO definition. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.11 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6.

environments.description: Provisioned environments (parity expected between staging and production).

rollback_path_tested.description: Automated rollback path tested per release.

observability_integrated.description: Client-side error tracking + Core Web Vitals monitoring wired up.

env_config.description: Per-environment config (API endpoints, broker URLs, feature flags).

performance_budgets.description: Core Web Vitals + error budgets for SLO definition.

lcp_ms.description: Largest Contentful Paint target in ms.

inp_ms.description: Interaction to Next Paint target in ms.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Frontend build/deploy pipeline configuration is agent-autonomous operational coordination.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (initial pipeline setup at project start; ongoing release-cycle coordination; pre-release infrastructure health check)
confirm_conditions: pipeline_provision declares build_stages, ≥1 environment, and rollback_path_tested = true
frontend performance budgets (LCP, INP, CLS, error rate) carry explicit units where set
reject_conditions: a production deploy with rollback_path_tested = false (no tested rollback)
a Core Web Vitals budget emitted without its unit
staging/production environment parity broken without disclosure
counter_conditions: requested build tooling unsupported by the current pipeline — request a toolchain onboarding plan
performance budget infeasible on the target CDN/region — request a budget renegotiation
